Interface ChangeStore<Self extends ChangeStore<Self,C>, C extends Change<C>>

Type Parameters:
Self - The type of implementation instance
C - The change to store
All Superinterfaces:
Comparable<Self>
All Known Subinterfaces:
ChangeStore.Multi<C>, ChangeStore.Single<C>
public interface ChangeStore<Self extends ChangeStore<Self,C>, C extends Change<C>> extends Comparable<Self>
A store for a single or multiple changes. This is designed to hold changes for 1 specific reason such as "blocks that are changing within a chunk" and not "blocks that are changing within a chunk and/or new heightmap values"

      @CheckReturnValue boolean insert(@NotNull C change)
      Inserts the change into the store. If the change conflicts with another change, the two will be compared with the loosing instance being removed from the changestore
      Parameters:
      change - The change to insert
      Returns:
      if the change was successfully inserted

    • copyInto

      @CheckReturnValue boolean copyInto(@NotNull @NotNull ChangeStore<?, ? super C> copy)
      Copies the current changes into the provided change store. Conflicts will be compared with the winner staying. Note: if one change fails, then no change will occur and the copy into is reverted back to its original state
      Parameters:
      copy - the change to copy the changes into
      Returns:
      if all changes was successful
